data.description: A yhohm can cause its feathers to burst into fire as a free action. As long as its feathers are burning (up to 10 rounds), it deals an additional 1d6 points of fire damage with each natural attack, and any creature within 5 feet must attempt a DC %1 Reflex save each round or take 1d6 points of fire damage at the start of its turn. A creature that attacks the yhohm with a natural or non-reach melee weapon takes 1d6 points of fire damage (no save) with each successful hit.
data.name: Shroud of Flame
